verified_location.value: Paarl, Western Cape (Stick's home market); Cape Town + Winelands is the broader customer footprint.
verified_location.source: Stick Golf Brand & Commercial Strategy 2026-2029, section 4 'Geographic position'

verified_not_sub_brand.value: Stick is a sister brand to Swing Shack under Stick Golf Group (Hermanus Kriel co-owner). NOT a sub-brand. Stick has its own studio, its own brand identity, its own product curation.
verified_not_sub_brand.source: Stick Brand Bible section 1 + Strategy section 1

verified_strategic_belief.value: Everything has to earn its place.

verified_trading_principles.value: Fit First. Buy Second. Why It's Here. Respect the Player.

verified_respect_the_player.value: Never use expertise to make the golfer feel stupid.
verified_respect_the_player.source: Stick Brand Commercial Strategy section 3 + Christelle directive 2026-09-23

verified_archetype.value: Smart Rebel — Rebel + Sage combined. Edge and brains. Not a punk brand. Not an engineering robot.

verified_brands_stocked.value: Takomo, Vice, Psycho Bunny, L.A.B Golf, Avoda, Vessel, RipIt.

verified_business_mix.value: Part fitting studio, part workshop, part modern golf retailer, part editor.

verified_services.value: Brand-agnostic TrackMan fittings. Full shaft matrix. Precision workshop. Purpose-built equipment.

verified_fitting_philosophy.value: Stick matches equipment to the player, not the player to the equipment.

verified_paarl_focus.value: The content should feel proudly Paarl without talking as though only Paarl golfers can buy, enquire or get fitted.

verified_why_its_here_format.value: Every priority product or partner brand gets the same editorial treatment: not a catalogue description, but Stick's reason for making space for it. Title frame: 'WHY IT'S HERE.'

verified_content_shares.value: Product & brands 40%, Fitting & proof 25%, Workshop & service 20%, Culture/style/people 15%. Starting shares, not quotas.

verified_meta_reach_data.value: Weekly Meta reach Aug 16-22: 87.1K (68.1K Facebook + 19.0K Instagram). Meta ad traffic Aug 11-24: 2,306 link clicks, blended CPC R0.42. GBP Mar-Aug: 1,161 interactions, 108 calls, 553 website clicks.

verified_history_evidence.value: Fit Fact 15 Jul-13 Aug: 44 leads at R20.10 each. Fit Fact 11-24 Aug: 24 lead-form results at R32.06 each. Takomo landing page avg engagement 2m08s. Search Console last 3 months: 1,079 impressions, 39 clicks.

banned_fabrications.value: No fake TrackMan numbers. No fake fitting outcomes. No fake '12-shot improvement' / 'two-week satisfaction guarantee' style claims. No fake member counts. No fake distance claims. Any number not in this file is not allowed in copy.
banned_fabrications.source: Stick Brand Bible section 7 + Numbers discipline + Christelle directive 2026-09-23

voice_constraints.value: Em dashes banned (use pipes, colons, commas, periods). One sentence per beat. Period as drumbeat. Sentence case. Cheeky AND helpful, never sarcasm-as-punchline. The joke is shared with the reader, never directed at them. Never use expertise to make the golfer feel stupid.
voice_constraints.source: Stick Brand Bible + Stick voice/tone-rules.md + Christelle directive 2026-09-23

tone.value: Cheeky and helpful. Sharp, modern, confident, informed, energetic, selective, culturally awake. Smart Rebel: edge and brains.
tone.source: Stick Brand Bible sections 11 + Christelle directive 2026-09-23

rules.exact_only: Only facts in verified_facts can appear in copy. All other claims need a verified source.
rules.no_fabrication: Never invent stats, member counts, distances, improvement percentages, satisfaction guarantees, or locations beyond Paarl/Cape Town/Winelands.
rules.voice_only: Cheeky and helpful, never sarcasm-as-punchline. Em dash ban. Period as drumbeat. Setup:payoff in two sentences max.
rules.respect_the_player: Every line lands on a thing we can help with. CTAs must be actionable.
